provenance.intro: The LFDT-CLPR repositories and commits this explainer describes, as of {{lastSynced}}.

footer: An explainer for CLPR, a bridgeless cross-ledger protocol developed as an LF Decentralized Trust lab, part of the CLPR website. It describes the repositories and commits listed above; the specification remains the reference.
Text is licensed CC BY 4.0; code and simulations are Apache-2.0. Contributions are signed off under the Developer Certificate of Origin.
